snippet.title: Montabi | Monster Taming Direct Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Montabi!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141630/Montabi/

Buddy showcases some synergies that Montabi can have during your runs.

Montabi is a creature-collector roguelite deckbuilder where you tame creatures and gather a team of Montabi to battle other tamers. Positioning is key! Move your Montabi in a 3x3 grid to advantageous positions to deal the most damage while avoiding the attacks of the enemy. Train your Montabi to grow stronger and learn new skills that you can add to your deck!

To learn more about Montabi, Akupara Games, and Mankibo visit:
►Montabi: https://www.akuparagames.com/game/montabi/
►Akupara Games: https://linktr.ee/akuparagames
►Mankibo: https://mankibo.com/
